about.title: Who Am I?
about.paragraph_management: Operational manager and digital project manager with over 8 years of experience in client relations, strategic support, and digital. Founder of a music marketing agency (500+ artists, 34M views). Startup co-founder with a Ledger co-creator.
about.paragraph_agency: Since 2018, I have founded and run my digital marketing agency, MDMC Music Ads. We support over 500 artists in building their strategy and growing their online fanbase.
about.paragraph_results: Our digital expertise has produced tangible results: over 1,500 campaigns launched, 34 million cumulative views, and an 8% conversion rate. Expertise in digital marketing, automation, and artificial intelligence.
about.paragraph_synthesis: Today, as co-founder of BandStream SAS with David Balland (Ledger co-creator), I apply this dual expertise—managerial and digital—to drive innovation in the music-tech ecosystem.
